newsitem.title: UK: Libya cuts March Es Sider crude by 10 cts - trade.
newsitem.headline: Libya cuts March Es Sider crude by 10 cts - trade.

text.p: Libya left most oil export price formulas unchanged for March loadings but cut the price of its key Es Sider crude by 10 cents a barrel, traders said.
Libya told customers Es Sider would sell for Dated Brent -5 cents for March, down from Dated Brent +5 cents in February.
Sirtica was also cut 10 cents to Brent +5 cents, from Brent +15 cents in February.

Zueitina and Brega were priced at Dated Brent +40 cents. Sarir was left at Dated Brent -55, Bu Attifel at Brent -30 and Amna at Brent -60. Bouri was priced at Iranian Heavy fob Sidi Kreir -35 cents, traders said.
